## Problem

What problem would this solve? Describe the user workflow, not just the feature.

## Proposal

What would you like WattLedger to do?

## Scope check

- [ ] This does not require a kernel driver.
- [ ] This does not require administrator rights for the core experience.
- [ ] This does not require network access or telemetry.
- [ ] If it is an estimate, it can be labelled as an estimate.

## Alternatives considered

Existing tools or workarounds you have tried.
